name: Keikyu-Kamata
tagline: Shinagawa in 18 minutes and Tokyo in 32 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, where Keikyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 38 minutes to Otemachi, 49 minutes to Shinjuku, 44 minutes to Shibuya and 18 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.5 m to 2.9 m, a difference of 1.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 蒲田3丁目店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 安田整形外科, about 1 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is ふたば歯科クリニック 蒲田院, about 2 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keikyu Main Line and Keikyu Airport Line. Both lines are run by Keikyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Keikyu Main Line runs at 120% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 戸部→横浜, which this station is not on. Keikyu Airport Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. In plain yen, though, it is on the low side for the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kamata is ahead on rail connections and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Keikyu-Kamata. Kamata also has the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, Tokyu Ikegami Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line, which Keikyu-Kamata does not. With more lines, Kamata is the better connected of the two. To Shinjuku, for instance, Kamata is 13 minutes quicker. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Umeyashiki; for rail connections, Keikyu-Kamata.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Keikyu-Kamata. Umeyashiki has only the Keikyu Main Line, so Keikyu-Kamata is the better connected. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On what it offers families, though, Umeyashiki comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 第一京浜 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
The nearest big road, 多摩堤通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 15 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
